contact.evidence_quote: Autonomous Section of Theory and History ... Born in Johannesburg in 1992, Maura Carneiro graduated from the Faculty of Fine Arts at the University of Porto. Her artistic practice integrates Fine Arts and Cinema, with professional roles as a production designer, art director and independent producer. Involved in both feature and short films, Maura has collaborated on projects across Portugal, Belgium, Syria, France, and Brazil.

alternates.evidence_quote: Vanessa Fernandes is a film director and multidisciplinar artist. Si destinu, a short-film about the MGF, Mikambaru, Tradition and Imagination and Fiji, are some of her video-performative projects. Her performances involve the Butoh movement and African dance as ritual, as shown in Lead and Cotton and Vortex. Fernades has also developed works in the field of installation such as Stand Here, presented in the 8th Triangle Network, Hangar, Art Research Centre (Lisbon).
